d: Short, spiky platinum white hair with swept bangs frames a youthful, adolescent face and wide, bright blue eyes. The build is slender and lean, dressed in a sleek white military-style outfit consisting of a high-collared tunic and matching trousers, accented by a black undershirt, a brown belt, and a long white coat with a deep purple lining. Black gloves and black shoes with brown straps complete the ensemble. The figure holds a long sword with a golden hilt and a dark blade.
